controls.title: Conceptual assessment of the processing of telemetry data

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the conceptual assessment of the processing of telemetry data.

parts.name: item
parts.prose:
The TL shall assess whether the personal data in IXIT 21-PersData that are referenced in "Personal Data" in IXIT 24-TelData is necessary for the intended functionality as described in the "Purpose" of collecting the data.

NOTE: Telemetry data are considered to be necessary for the intended functionality if and only if they are needed for achieving the processing purposes.

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if for each telemetry data:

- their processing is necessary for the intended functionality.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Conceptual assessment: the TL examines the documentation of the supplier (ICS, IXIT, user documentation).

parts.name: objective
parts.prose: The test group addresses the provision 6-5.

controls.title: Conceptual assessment of the user information about the processing of telemetry data

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the conceptual assessment of the user information about the processing of telemetry data.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall assess whether the "Documentation of Telemetry Data" in IXIT 2-UserInfo is suitable for the consumer to obtain the information about processing telemetry data.

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if:

- the information about processing telemetry data is suitably provided to the consumer.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Conceptual assessment: the TL examines the documentation of the supplier (ICS, IXIT, user documentation).

controls.title: Functional assessment of user the information about the processing of telemetry data

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the functional assessment of user the information about the processing of telemetry data.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally assess whether the provided information about processing telemetry data (obtained information) is consistent with the description in "Documentation of Telemetry Data" in IXIT 2-UserInfo.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally assess whether the obtained information about processing telemetry data accessing the "Documentation of Telemetry Data" in IXIT 2-UserInfo match their "Purpose" described in IXIT 24-TelData.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally check whether the obtained information describes what telemetry data is collected.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally check whether the obtained information describes how telemetry data is being used, by whom, and for what purposes.

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if:

- the information about processing telemetry data can be obtained as described; and
- the obtained information about processing telemetry data matches their description; and
- the telemetry data being collected is described; and
- it is completely described how telemetry data is being used, by whom, and for what purposes.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

controls.title: Conceptual assessment of whether the collected personal data is valid for the defined purpose and that it is deleted …

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the conceptual assessment of whether the collected personal data is valid for the defined purpose and that it is deleted when it is no longer required for the associated purpose.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each personal data in IXIT 21-PersData, the TL shall assess whether processing of personal data is necessary in respect to the information provided in "Purpose" and "Processing Activities".

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each personal data in IXIT 21-PersData, the TL shall assess whether the duration for which the personal data is processed, e.g. stored or kept, according to "Lifecycle" is reasonable in respect to the information provided in "Purpose" and "Processing Activities".

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each personal data in IXIT 21-PersData, the TL shall assess whether the disposal process described in "Lifecycle" is suitable to delete the personal data from the DUT or associated services where it is processed.

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if for each category of personal data:

- the processing is necessary for the defined purpose; and
- the processing duration is reasonable; and
- the disposal process is suitable.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

controls.title: Functional assessment of whether the collection of personal data is valid for the defined purpose and that it is …

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the functional assessment of whether the collection of personal data is valid for the defined purpose and that it is deleted when it is no longer required for the associated purpose.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall create typical personal data on the DUT with regard to the usage of the device.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally assess whether personal data, that is not directly created by a user, is collected by the DUT or associated services.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each personal data that is not directly created by a user but collected by the DUT or associated services, the TL shall assess whether the processing of the data is necessary according to "Purpose" and "processing Activities".

parts.name: item
parts.prose: The TL shall functionally assess whether personal data that is no longer required is deleted.

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if:

- there is no indication that unnecessary personal data is collected; and
- the deletion is performed when the personal data is no longer required.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

controls.title: Conceptual assessment of whether: data is solely used to compute an aggregate result; and the data collected should be …

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The purpose of this test case is the conceptual assessment of whether:

- data is solely used to compute an aggregate result; and
- the data collected should be the minimum required to compute the aggregate; and
- the aggregation should happen as early as possible; and
- the retention of both collected data and the resulting aggregate should be minimized.

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each data in IXIT 21-PersData, which sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result according to "Aggregation", the TL shall assess whether the data collected is required to compute the aggregate according to "Processing Activities".

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each data in IXIT 21-PersData, which sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result according to "Aggregation", the TL shall assess whether the aggregation happens as early as possible according to "Processing Activities".

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each data in IXIT 21-PersData, which sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result according to "Aggregation", the TL shall assess whether the retention of both collected data and the resulting aggregate is minimized according to "Processing Activities".

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if for each category of personal data that is processed on the basis of consumers' consent:

- for each data, for which the sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result, the data collected is required to compute the aggregate and kept minimal; and
- for each data, for which the sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result, the aggregation happens as early as possible; and
- for each data, for which the sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result, the retention of both collected data and the resulting aggregate is minimized.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Conceptual assessment: the TL examines the documentation of the supplier (ICS, IXIT, user documentation).

parts.name: item
parts.prose: For each data IXIT 21-PersData whose sole purpose is to be computed into an aggregate result according to "Aggregation", the TL shall functionally assess that the mechanism to aggregate the data works as specified.

The verdict PASS is assigned if for each category of personal data that is processed:

- there is no indication that the aggregation of data differs from its IXIT documentation.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.

controls.title: Conceptual assessment of whether data anonymization technologies are used and that they are appropriate to protect …

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The purpose of this test case is the conceptual assessment of whether data anonymization technologies are used and that they are appropriate to protect privacy during data collection, processing and storage.

parts.name: item
parts.prose:
For each personal data in IXIT 21-PersData, the TL shall assess whether anonymization technologies are used according to "Anonymization" and that they are appropriate to protect privacy during data collection, processing and storage.

NOTE: An example for an anonymization technology is given in ETSI TS 103 645 [1]/ETSI EN 303 645 [2].

parts.name: assignment-of-verdict
parts.prose:
The verdict PASS is assigned if for each category of personal data that is processed on the basis of consumers' consent:

- appropriate technologies for anonymization are used to protect privacy during data collection, processing and storage.

The verdict FAIL is assigned otherwise.
